maria: Heads-up: after last night's proxy TLS rotation we're seeing DCGM scrape latency jump on a subset of GPU nodes. Started ~02:45 UTC, alerts fired.

kevin: Saw the alerts too — dcgm_scrape_latency_seconds p50 went from ~0.5s to 6-12s for a bunch of targets. Prometheus shows a bunch of 5xx/timeouts to the exporter endpoints.

lee: I'm seeing TLS handshake errors from kube-proxy/sidecar when talking to node-exporter/dcgm-exporter on the node. Example from node logs:
```
2026-03-18T02:46:12Z kube-proxy sidecar: tls: handshake error from 10.5.2.14:57892: EOF
2026-03-18T02:46:13Z dcgm-exporter: connection reset by peer
```

maria: This was the managed proxy cert rotation we ran last night (proxy-rotation). Deploy notes mentioned additional CA chain but nothing about metric exemptions. @deploy-bot did the rotation include any config changes?

deploy-bot: Completed proxy rotation: proxy-rotation v2.1.4 deployed 2026-03-18T02:30:00Z. No additional allowlist changes were applied.

kevin: Likely cause: mutual TLS verification now failing for the exporter client because metrics port isn't in the proxy allowlist, or the proxy is doing stricter SNI verification. Quick workaround: bypass proxy for metrics traffic on nodes.

lee: I applied a temporary iptables bypass on affected nodes to confirm:
```bash
# run on node
iptables -t nat -I OUTPUT 1 -p tcp --dport 9400 -j ACCEPT
iptables -t nat -I OUTPUT 1 -p tcp --dport 9100 -j ACCEPT
```
Prometheus target health recovered after this on the nodes I patched (p95 latency back ~1.2s).

maria: Good verification. We should still do a proper fix — either update proxy config to exempt exporter ports (9100/9400) or update exporter clients to present the right cert/SNI. Also need an automated test so future cert rotations don't regress metrics.

kevin: Action items I'll take: 1) open RFC for metrics port exemptions + e2e for proxy rotations, 2) add a temporary Alert runbook hook to auto-skip proxy for known monitoring ports if rotation detected, 3) roll forward a proxy config change next maintenance window.

lee: I'll collect node logs from the patched hosts and send a gist with the TLS traces.

oncall-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-042 - dcgm scrape latency after proxy TLS rotation. Pager duty notified.

maria: Thanks. Keep this thread updated with the RFC link and the gist. If anyone else sees a node still failing ping me directly. :thumbsup:
